JoinEmpty.description_en:
Specifies whether to allow calls to join the queue when no available agents are present. If the maximum queue length is set, calls wait in the queue and overflow only after a timeout. If specific agent statuses are selected, agents in these statuses are considered unavailable, and calls overflow immediately to reduce customer wait time. Valid values:
1: Busy.
2: On a call.
4: Ringing.
8: Invalid.
16: Wrap-up.
To select multiple statuses, pass the sum of the corresponding values. For example, to select Busy and On a call, set the value to 3
JoinEmpty.description_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join（设置了队列等待数，来电进入队列后处于等待状态，等待超时才溢出；如果勾选了这几个选项，认为座席不可用，直接溢出，减少客户等待时间）， 1: 置忙；2: 通话中；4: 振铃；8: 无效；16: 整理。 如选多种状态则传对应数值的和，如选置忙和通话中，值为 3

Strategy.description_en:
The call routing strategy. Valid values:
1: Sequential.
2: Round-robin.
3: Average.
4: Random.
5: Skill-based priority.
6: Longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call.
7: Skill-based priority + longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call.
8: Longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call (entire queue).
9: Skill-based priority + longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call (entire queue).
10: Average across the entire queue.
11: Skill-based priority + round-robin.
12: Longest idle time.
13: Skill-based priority + longest current idle time.
14: Longest cumulative idle time since the last call
Strategy.description_zh: 呼叫策略，1：顺序，2：轮选，3：平均，4：随机，5：技能优先，6：距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长，7：技能优先+距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长，8：距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长(全队列)，9：技能优先+距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长(全队列)，10：全队列平均，11：技能优先+轮选，12：最长空闲时长，13：技能优先+当前空闲状态时长最长，14：距上一通通话空闲时间累计最长

Weight.description_en: The queue priority. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1. When an agent belongs to multiple queues, calls from the queue with a higher priority are answered first. A larger value indicates a higher priority
Weight.description_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围 1-10。默认值为 1，座席属于多个队列时，优先级高的队列的来电将优先接听；数值越高，优先级越高
